notes: Encoded from Modine's own page only. Styles 1a/1b share one shape and are merged into year-only length-split styles (see style-1a-11 notes): the page distinguishes month (older) from week (newer) by era, not by shape, so month and week cannot both ship without a shape collision. Parent as stated on the page: Modine.

styles.notes: Page styles 1a and 1b: 11- or 12-digit all-numeric serial, year = last two digits ([9,11] here). SHAPE COLLISION HOLD: 1a says the two digits preceding the year are month (older units) and 1b says they are week (newer units, last decade +/-) — the same shape, so a serial with preceding digits <= 12 (e.g. 01121010691) would decode as both month 06 and week 06. Month and week are therefore both held and this family ships year-only. Page examples for both 1a (01121010691 -> 1991) and 1b (01121013609 -> 2009) decode under the year rule.

CONSTRUCTED example (labeled): the page states the 11-or-12-digit form with year = last two digits but gives no 12-digit example; this 12-digit serial decodes under the stated rule alone ([10,12] = '99' -> 1999). Month/week held for the same shape-collision reason as style-1a-11.

styles.era: 11-digit sequence + 4-digit hyphen suffix, year only (styles 1a/1b family)
styles.notes: Page: the year stays coded in the first 11- or 12-digit sequence, NOT the last four digits after the hyphen. Normalized (dash stripped) the 11+4 form is 15 digits and the year is positions [9,11] of the normalized serial. Page example form with the page's '-1234' suffix placeholder. Month/week held for the same shape-collision reason as style-1a-11.

styles.era: 12-digit sequence + 4-digit hyphen suffix, year only (styles 1a/1b family)
styles.notes: CONSTRUCTED example (labeled): the page states the hyphen-suffix rule for the 11-or-12-digit sequence but gives no 12+4 example; this serial decodes under the stated rule alone (normalized 16 digits, year = [10,12] = '99' -> 1999). Month/week held for the same shape-collision reason as style-1a-11.

styles.era: 14-character serials, 6 digits + 3 letters + 5 digits, year + month
styles.notes: Page: year = 1st-4th numerical digits ([0,4] = '2001', four-digit year used as-is), month = 5th-6th numerical digits ([4,6] = '08' = August). Leading digits, so character and digit-only counting coincide.

styles.era: 9-character serials, 2 digits + 5 letters + 3 digits, year only
styles.notes: Page: year = 1st-2nd numerical digits ([0,2] = '97' -> 1997). DESCRIPTION/EXAMPLE DISCREPANCY: the page description says five letters, but the page example 97JKGK153 has four letters (J,K,G,K) — 2 + 4 + 3 = 9 characters. The example wins: the pattern follows the example (4 letters). Month = 3rd character, chart-only (page image for this style), so month is null and the style ships year-only pending the image pass.

Page: year = 6th-7th numerical digits, month = 8th-9th numerical digits. COUNTING: digit-only counting is FALSIFIED — the serial has only five numerical digits, so 6th-7th numerical digits do not exist under digit-only counting. Character counting ships: year = characters 6-7 ([5,7] = '87' -> 1987), month = characters 8-9 ([7,9] = '01' = January).
